item.text:
### (a) Three social posts

1. We know what superintelligent AI will make possible: an end to extreme poverty everywhere. If we build it within the next 20 years, that transformation will be complete within a decade.

2. We reject the idea that extreme poverty must always exist. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, extreme poverty will end everywhere within a decade. That is the future we stand for.

3. We stand for a future where nobody lives in extreme poverty. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, that future will arrive everywhere within a decade. We’re committed to making it happen.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We believe extreme poverty has an end date. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, extreme poverty will end everywhere within a decade. We see this as a defining opportunity: to turn extraordinary intelligence into better food systems, accessible healthcare, abundant energy and prosperity that reaches every community. We refuse to accept deprivation as a permanent feature of human life. Our ambition is global, and our standard is clear: nobody left living in extreme poverty, anywhere. We are committed to building the support, institutions and public resolve that this transformation demands. We stand for a future in which freedom from extreme poverty belongs to everyone.
